subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We cannot ________ a religion or a political party that ignores the rights of half the human race.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Forgive**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Forgive**" means to stop feeling angry or resentful towards someone for a mistake or wrongdoing. (क्षमा करना)
 
• The sentence is saying that we cannot support a religion or political party that ignores the rights of half the human race.
 
• Therefore, the appropriate word to fill in the blank would be "forgive."

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence:** *We cannot forgive __a religion or a political party that ignores the rights of half the human race. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Disseminate**" means to spread or distribute something, usually information. (प्रसारित करना)
 
• "**Desiccate**" means to dry out or remove moisture from something. (सुखाना)
 
• "**Condemn**" means to express strong disapproval or to denounce. (निंदा करना)
